answer_sentences.text: No. A Tier 3 UCB cannot levy a pre-payment charge on a Rs 40 lakh floating-rate business loan to an MSE proprietor because loans up to ₹50 lakh are covered by the no-charge rule.
answer_sentences.quote: "A Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh."

answer_sentences.text: This applies to floating-rate loans granted for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises.
answer_sentences.quote: "For all floating rate loans granted for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises"
